violation_type.title: Outdoor Space Requirements - At Least 25% of Indoor Capacity (26 TAC §746.4301(b))
violation_type.short_title: Outdoor Space Requirements - At Least 25% of Indoor Capacity
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation does not have enough square footage in the outdoor activity space to equal at least 25% of the licensed indoor capacity.

finding_variants.text: The operation does not have enough square footage in the outdoor activity space to equal at least 25% of the licensed indoor capacity.
